title: Bone (عظمة): co-op game from Saudi developer DRTH, maker of Aunt Fatima, Steam page and trailer, published by SAAF Interactive

sources.name: DRTH (@Drth7) on X: teaser and Steam link

claims.text: 4-player online co-op; skeletons escort a fragile orb on a wagon
Developer Abdulla Al Hamad (DRTH), publisher SAAF Interactive (Saudi), partnership announced 15 Oct
PC (Windows) on Steam, English and Arabic with full audio, Coming soon, no date
Maker of Aunt Fatima - خالة فاطمة (Steam 3030250, 31 Oct 2024)

notes: Dated from 15 Oct (4 days at first report): kept as regional news the wider press missed (first press Saudi Gamer 19 Oct 19:28Z). Developer's name spelt two ways in the press (آل حمد, الحمد); copy uses DRTH.
